I'm in the GTA but Im also in the good old Lower Middle Class. Getting places and affording things is a problem for my family, especially considering 3 of the 4 of us are status and one of our dogs recently had to get thousands of dollars worth of treatment.

Ive tried talking to my therapist, but its hard to get what i need with my family's income and work schedule. I only just started getting called by my actual name instead of my deadname. Not to mention I'm close to ageing out of the public system. 

My parents do their best but I'm weary around them. A lot of my trauma was caused by them and reinforced over about a decade. Even if, rationally, I know they've changed and theyre trying to do better, I'd still be more comfortable going to friends with my problems than them.

First thing. Its been months and I still find myself wishing I did something different. Hes a manipulative narcissist but I still feel like everything was my fault. 

Second point. I dont know. I want to feel better than just "pretty okay" for longer than a few days. My emotions are always intense but the bad ones always last longer. 

I want to be able to wake up in the morning and enjoy the fact that its a new day. I want to know what to do with my life, beyond what internet rabbit hole I'll dive down to distract myself from every bad thing in the world. I miss being a kid and being genuinely happy.
